8. SCOPE OF WORK: Site survey and confirmation of final room dimensions before fabrication.

Removal and dismantling of the existing freezer cold storage room (10.00 × 4.00 × 3.00 m) — wall and ceiling panels; insulated floor system comprising PUF floor panel, marine plywood and MS chequered plate; door; condensing unit; evaporator; piping and electrical accessories — including safe stacking of the items to be re-used and clearing of all debris from site.
Supply and installation of 100 mm PUF sandwich panels with new aluminium angles to walls and ceiling (total 124.00 sqm).
Re-installation of the client's existing hinged cold room door (900 × 1900 mm), including frame alignment, gasket adjustment and hardware re-fixing.

Supply and installation of new concrete flooring with epoxy finish (40.00 sqm) — damp-proof membrane, A142 mesh reinforcement, 100 mm C25/30 reinforced screed power-float finished, three-coat food-grade epoxy to nominal 2 mm, and 100 mm epoxy coving to all wall-to-floor junctions.
Re-installation of the client's existing condensing unit, evaporator and control panel (1 set), including mounting, fixing and re-connection.
Refrigeration interconnecting copper piping, armaflex insulation and insulated drain line.

Electrical re-wiring from the cold room control panel onward — including power, control wiring, internal LED light and door frame heater connections, and re-connection of the existing control panel and safeties.
Aluminium coving, corner angles, silicone sealing and full vapour sealing.
Pressure testing, vacuum, refrigerant gas charging, testing and commissioning.
Handover to client with operational check and demonstration of the installed system.
9. EXCLUSIONS: Performance of the re-used refrigeration equipment. The existing condensing unit and evaporator are re-installed and tested, but their cooling capacity, condition and remaining service life are not warranted by TNDK.

Floor insulation. The existing insulated floor panel is removed and replaced with a concrete slab at the client's instruction. No thermal insulation is included beneath the new floor, and TNDK accepts no liability for frost heave, slab cracking or loss of holding temperature arising from an uninsulated floor in freezer service.
Civil works, foundation, leveling and any structural support beyond the concrete flooring quoted in item 4.
Power supply (Main DB), main cable run from MDB to cold room control panel.
Any false ceiling removal, modifications or restoration of existing finishes.
Drain piping beyond 3 m from the evaporator drain outlet.
Backup power, UPS, generator or stabilizer.
Telephone, CCTV, BMS or IoT integration (available on request — separately quoted).
Any duties or municipality fees other than those explicitly mentioned.
Lifting equipment / cranes if access requires more than standard manual handling.
Working at heights above 3 m (additional scaffolding cost shall apply).
Any item not specifically listed in the Scope of Work.
